choices: Sets the line drawing width to 3 pixels
Sets the opacity of drawn shapes to 30%
Sets the color to a shade of gray
explanation: BasicStroke controls the width and style of lines drawn by draw() calls (drawLine, drawRect, etc.). new BasicStroke(3f) makes lines 3 pixels wide. You can also control end caps and line joins: new BasicStroke(3f, BasicStroke.CAP_ROUND, BasicStroke.JOIN_ROUND).
